messages.subject: Machine Learning and AI for Researchers - Livestream Seminars
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is excited to offer two dynamic seminars on machine learning and AI for researchers: Machine Learning and AI for Researchers in R with Dr Giovanni Cerulli, running February 20–21, and Machine Learning and AI in Python with Dr Kimberly Fessel, running February 27–28. These seminars provide comprehensive, hands-on training in state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and AI applications using two of the most popular programming environments. Designed for academics, researchers, and professionals, the sessions combine theoretical insights with practical exercises to help you harness the power of data science in your research—whether you work in R or Python.

Sign up for both today and get an automatic 10% discount on these excellent seminars, and feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
